hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1% base fee plus a per-pool creator tax (up to 10%) on swaps denominated in a configured payment token. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and redeemable to immutable protocol and creator recipients; pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to a designated factory and position manager.
